sourceHeader.time: 1 Reaction, which you take when you see a creature within range take damage.
sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Tactile, Visual), Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release.

system.description:
You focus your Chakra, accelerating or decelerating the impact of an attack or jutsu, lessening or multiplying its force.

Accelerate. The target takes 2d10 extra Wind or Lightning damage from the triggering instance of damage.

Decelerate. Reduce the damage dealt by the triggering instance of damage by 2d10.

Interdiction Seal. A creature marked with this seal that takes additional damage or has their damage reduced, must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the seal triggers, with chains shooting from it, connecting to the ground until the end of their next turn. For the duration, a creature that failed their saving throw cannot move more than 5 feet from their current space and take a -1 penalty to dexterity saving throws.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage dealt or reduced by 1d10.
